Christina McCallum is a recent graduate of the Master of Data Science in Computational Linguistics (MDS-CL) program at the University of British Columbia. Prior to the program, she worked in book publishing and tech, and holds a Master of Arts in Literature. As a language enthusiast, she's worked on diverse writing, editorial, and CL-related projects. In her spare time, she enjoys reading contemporary fiction, doing silly crafts, and strolling along the beach.
